data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 外骨骼射击训练】地下实弹射击场内，时装备着高机动外骨骼装甲「Abi-Eshuh」稳稳端起突击步枪。枪口火光吞吐间十发全中靶心，金发从护目镜旁飘散。她放下武器转过头——「所有目标均已彻底清除。主人的安全评级已上升至最高标准……呼呼，毫无破绽。」
data.promptProse: Toki aims an assault rifle at the underground range while wearing the Abi-Eshuh exoskeleton over her maid combat outfit, blonde strands escaping beside her goggles. After the shot she lowers the weapon and turns toward the viewer. The low upper-body close-up holds the rifle and armor joints, with target lanes behind. Cool training lights define the armor planes, and muzzle flash briefly warms her glove and barrel edge.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 外骨骼射击训练
